dotnet_help.intent: Get help for a specific dotnet command. Use this to discover available options for any dotnet command.

dotnet_dev_certs.intent: Manage developer certificates and user secrets for secure local development. Provides a consolidated interface for certificate trust/management and user secrets storage.

dotnet_workload.intent: Manage .NET workloads for specialized development scenarios (MAUI, WASM, etc.). Provides a consolidated interface for installing, updating, listing, searching, and uninstalling workloads.

dotnet_package.intent: Manage NuGet packages and project references. Provides a unified interface for all package and reference operations including adding/removing packages, searching NuGet.org, updating packages, managing

dotnet_server_capabilities.intent: Get a machine-readable JSON snapshot of server capabilities, versions, and supported features for agent orchestration and discovery.

dotnet_project.intent: Manage .NET project lifecycle including creation, building, testing, running, and publishing. Provides a unified interface for all project operations including new project creation, building, running,

dotnet_ef.intent: Manage Entity Framework Core operations including migrations, database updates, and DbContext scaffolding. Provides a unified interface for all EF Core CLI operations. Note: Requires dotnet-ef tool to

dotnet_sdk.intent: Query .NET SDK, runtime, template, and framework information. Provides a unified interface for all SDK-related queries including version info, installed SDKs and runtimes, template discovery, framewor

dotnet_tool.intent: Manage .NET tools (global, local, and tool manifests). Provides a unified interface for all .NET tool operations including installation, updates, searching, running, and manifest management.

unload.intent: Unloads the current in-memory workspace and stops file watching. Use before external builds or IDE work when analyzer/source-generator locks need to be released.

write_file.intent: Writes a .cs file under the loaded root. Uses preview-first behavior by default and explicitly updates or reloads the workspace after applyChanges=true. Requires a loaded solution.

find_code.intent: Recommended first-call code navigation router. Symbol-first by default; delegates to semantic tools, outlines, or literal text search. Requires a loaded solution.

get_outgoing_calls.intent: Finds methods called by a method body with depth-limited expansion and paging. May return partial results for large graphs/timeouts. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

find_unused_symbols.intent: Finds likely-unused source symbols with zero non-self references. Skips generated code, overrides/interface implementations, and reflection-sensitive symbols by default. Scope selects definitions to a

find_external_dependency_usages.intent: Finds source usages of symbols that come from an external referenced assembly, keyed by simple assembly name or full metadata reference identity. Returns project, file, and symbol summaries to help pl

get_project_format_summary.intent: Summarizes project formats/kinds for SDK-style migration planning. Requires a loaded solution.

server_status.intent: Returns server readiness, workspace state and loading ETA, cache revision, file-watcher stats, scout availability, and lastLoadError when the most recent load failed. Use before solution-scoped tools.

load.intent: Loads a C# solution/project into the in-memory workspace. Run before semantic tools. Watches the git repo root by default; see workingDirectory and noWatch.

find_references.intent: Primary semantic reference search. Use instead of searching identifier text. Supports scope, kind filters, grouping, and paging. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

move_type.intent: Moves a type to another file and/or namespace, updates references/usings, and returns a diff. Use applyChanges=false to preview before writing files. Requires a loaded solution.

get_structure.intent: Gets a compact C# file outline. Use instead of reading whole files when you need types, members, or declarations. Requires a loaded solution.

format_document.intent: Formats a C# document and returns a diff. Use after code edits/refactors to normalize layout/style. Requires a loaded solution.

find_implementations.intent: Finds implementations of an interface/abstract type or member. Requires a symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

sync.intent: Syncs content-only .cs edits from disk into the loaded workspace. If paths are omitted, runs only for pending watcher changes unless forceSync=true. Requires a loaded solution.

get_cascade_impact.intent: Builds on analyze_change_impact to expand callers, implementations, and overrides transitively up to a requested depth. Returns blast-radius summaries by depth, project, and file, plus paged impacted

move_member.intent: Moves a member between types, updates references, and returns a diff. Use applyChanges=false to preview before applying. Requires a loaded solution.

organize_usings.intent: Removes unnecessary usings and sorts the rest, returning a diff. Use for cleanup after edits/refactors. Requires a loaded solution.

find_callers.intent: Finds methods that invoke a target method, with caller aggregation and paging. May return partial results on timeout. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

reload.intent: Fully reloads workspace state from disk. Use after structural/project/reference changes. Requires a loaded solution.

view_external_definition.intent: Returns source for external symbols from referenced assemblies (SourceLink first, decompile fallback), with metadata. Use when symbol source is outside the loaded workspace. Requires a loaded solution

rename_symbol.intent: Renames a symbol across the loaded workspace and returns a diff. Prefer symbolKey input for precise targeting; use applyChanges=false for preview-first flow. Requires a loaded solution.

get_method_source.intent: Gets source for a specific method with location metadata. Use maxLines/bodyOnly to control output size. For external types, use view_external_definition. Requires a loaded solution.

get_symbol_info.intent: Gets normalized symbol details by symbolKey (signature, docs, locations, and structured method/type payloads when applicable). Prefer after discovery or whenever exact symbol identity matters. Require

find_unused_parameters.intent: Finds likely-unused parameters with zero references inside their declaring method or constructor. Skips generated code, overrides/interface implementations, and reflection-sensitive members by default

search_text.intent: Fallback literal/regex search for comments, strings, config-like text, or non-symbol text. Do not use for C# references/navigation. Delegates to scout when installed (see data.backend).

find_member_in_hierarchy.intent: Walks a member override chain and returns the declared origin plus chain nodes. Requires symbolKey for a method/property/event. Requires a loaded solution.

find_package_consolidation_candidates.intent: Find package version drift. Requires a loaded solution.

get_project_graph.intent: Analyzes the loaded workspace at the project-reference level. Returns direct edges, roots/leaves, transitive reachability counts, and cycle groups. Use for architecture review and project-reference im

get_type_dependencies.intent: Analyzes type dependencies in both directions (uses/used_by). Use for architecture review and refactor impact checks. Requires a loaded solution.

get_type_info.intent: Gets semantic details for a type (members, inheritance, docs) from the loaded workspace. For external types, use view_external_definition.

batch.intent: Runs multiple independent tool calls sequentially in one request to reduce round-trips. Returns per-operation results in order. Nested batch calls are not allowed.

get_type_source.intent: Gets source for a type declaration with span metadata from the loaded workspace. For external types, use view_external_definition. Requires a loaded solution.

get_file_contents.intent: Gets text content for a file under the loaded root, with optional line-window limits. Supports files outside the loaded workspace when they are still inside the loaded root. Requires a loaded solution

semantic_query.intent: Finds structural C# code patterns by semantic predicates. Use instead of regex for modifiers, types, attributes, or symbol shape. Requires a loaded solution.

get_diagnostics.intent: Gets structured compiler/analyzer diagnostics with locations and severity. Prefer for incremental analysis loops instead of full CLI builds.

find_unused_project_references.intent: Tests each direct ProjectReference by removing it in memory and checking whether new compiler errors appear in the referencing project. First pass is limited to ProjectReference entries and does not a

get_derived_types.intent: Derived-only convenience subset of get_type_hierarchy with simpler paging. Prefer get_type_hierarchy when you also need base types or interfaces. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

get_symbol_at_position.intent: Resolves the symbol at a file position and returns its symbolKey. Use when you have file/line/column context from code or text search. Requires a loaded solution.

find_package_usages.intent: Maps a NuGet package from project.assets.json to compile assemblies and metadata reference identities, then summarizes semantic source usages of that package. Use when you need package-level impact ra

analyze_complexity.intent: Analyzes cyclomatic complexity and size metrics per type/method. Use to prioritize refactoring candidates. Requires a loaded solution.

get_method_signature.intent: Gets a method signature (parameters, return type, docs) by method name or symbolKey (which disambiguates overloads). Fully qualified names work when containingTypeName is omitted. Requires a loaded so

find_overrides.intent: Finds overrides of a virtual/abstract member. Fails for non-overridable members. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

search_symbols.intent: Primary C# symbol discovery by name/pattern. Use instead of text/grep for identifiers before selecting a symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

diagnostic_hotspots.intent: Groups diagnostics into hotspots by file, project, category, or ID with severity counts and optional example diagnostics. Use when you want grouped cleanup targets before drilling into raw diagnostics

analyze_change_impact.intent: Summarizes refactor blast radius for a symbol (references, callers, implementations, overrides). Use before rename/move operations. Requires symbolKey. Requires a loaded solution.

resolve_symbol.intent: Shortest semantic path from known name/pattern to candidate symbolKeys for follow-up tools. Requires a loaded solution.

consolidate_package_version.intent: Rewrite one package version. Requires a loaded solution.

get_type_hierarchy.intent: Primary type hierarchy tool. Gets base types, interfaces, and derived types for a type in one call, with separate paging for derived types. Use get_derived_types only when you want the derived list al

trace_compare_sessions.intent: Compares two stored GliderTrace sessions and highlights fixed, new, and persisting evidence.

trace_run_tests.intent: Runs dotnet test under the workspace, captures stdout/stderr/TRX evidence, optionally reruns safe failures, and stores a GliderTrace test session.

trace_get_session.intent: Returns GliderTrace session metadata, compact summary, artifact references, and optional top findings.

trace_export.intent: Exports a compact GliderTrace agent summary or zip artifact reference for a session.

trace_stop.intent: Stops an active trace_start session, terminates the launched process, and finalizes stored evidence.

trace_capture_gcdump.intent: Captures an explicit sensitive GC dump artifact from an already-running local .NET process.

trace_list_processes.intent: Lists local .NET processes published through the diagnostics IPC channel for trace_attach.

trace_remove_workspace.intent: Removes a workspace root that was registered at runtime via trace_add_workspace (narrowing the sandbox). Admin-configured --workspace roots cannot be removed.

trace_correlate_code.intent: Maps stored GliderTrace stack-frame evidence to Glider-compatible C# symbol references.

trace_status.intent: Returns GliderTrace readiness, workspace/artifact configuration, package expiration, retention/redaction defaults, and optional local diagnostic capability details.

trace_add_workspace.intent: Registers an additional trusted workspace root at runtime (like glider load) so trace tools can target a sibling repository without restarting the server. Requires the server to be started with --allo

trace_import_otlp.intent: Imports bounded OpenTelemetry JSON or NDJSON evidence from a workspace file into a GliderTrace session.

trace_counters.intent: Summarizes collected dotnet-counters CSV artifacts for a GliderTrace session.

trace_hotspots.intent: Summarizes CPU sample hotspots from collected runtime.nettrace artifacts for a GliderTrace session.

trace_start.intent: Starts a long-running command under the workspace and stores an active GliderTrace runtime session.

trace_import_artifacts.intent: Imports existing workspace or artifact-root TRX, log, counters, nettrace, dump, or GC dump files into a GliderTrace session.

trace_attach.intent: Collects a bounded runtime.nettrace artifact from an already-running local .NET process.

trace_exceptions.intent: Groups exception evidence for a GliderTrace session by type, message, and first stack frame.

trace_capture_dump.intent: Captures an explicit sensitive process dump artifact from an already-running local .NET process.

trace_query_events.intent: Queries normalized GliderTrace evidence events by session, kind, text, severity, and cursor.

trace_run.intent: Runs a command under the workspace, captures stdout/stderr evidence, and stores a GliderTrace runtime session.

browser_click.intent: Perform click on a web page

browser_drag.intent: Perform drag and drop between two elements

browser_select_option.intent: Select an option in a dropdown

browser_tabs.intent: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

browser_wait_for.intent: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

conversations_list.intent: List active messaging conversations, optionally filtered by platform or name.

conversation_get.intent: Inspect one conversation's details using its session key.

messages_read.intent: Read recent message history from a selected conversation.

attachments_fetch.intent: Fetch non-text attachments from a specific message.

events_poll.intent: Poll for new conversation or approval events after a cursor.

events_wait.intent: Wait for the next conversation or approval event with a bounded timeout.

messages_send.intent: Send a text message through a connected platform target.

channels_list.intent: List available messaging targets across connected platforms.

permissions_list_open.intent: List pending approval requests observed by the bridge session.

permissions_respond.intent: Allow or deny a pending approval request.

memory_write.intent: Persist a durable, project-scoped fact with its source path — one fact per entry, never raw chatter.

memory_list.intent: List entries in a project's memory bank, optionally filtered.

memory_delete.intent: Delete a specific memory entry by id.

memory_delete_context.intent: Delete entries by context; requires full access mode.

memory_ingest_file.intent: Bulk-load a file's contents into project memory as entries.

memory_ingest_directory.intent: Bulk-load every supported file under a directory into project memory.

memory_embed_pending.intent: Embed pending entries; omit the limit argument to process all.

memory_workspace_begin.intent: Start an isolated workspace outbox for in-progress notes.

memory_workspace_status.intent: List what the active workspace outbox holds.

memory_workspace_consolidate.intent: Finish a workspace: keep durable facts, promote cross-project ones with memory_share, drop the rest.

memory_workspace_discard.intent: Discard an active workspace and its outbox without consolidating.

memory_sweep.intent: Remove old, low-rated project entries; shared entries are exempt.

memory_sync.intent: Exchange memory snapshots with cloud storage when configured.

memory_watch_add.intent: Register an absolute path to mirror into memory; the initial scan runs in the background.

memory_watch_status.intent: Report watch state (scanning/healthy/retrying/stopped) for a project; empty when none.

memory_watch_remove.intent: Stop mirroring a watched path; a no-op when the path is not watched.
